notes:
A CORRECTION, NOT A NEW ADJUDICATION. bmdb 1541 hostap batch 4 (src/crypto/crypto_openssl.c .. src/eap_common/eap_eke_common.c). Same standard and method as batches 1-3 (see correction-api00c-644-hostap-b1-task1541): each task-644-full-reaudit row re-derived at hostap dcee6043 under the bmdb 769 API00-C standard, per flagged parameter (the one realworld run 274 names at the key). A parameter counts as validated only by a genuine guard on the parameter itself, by every real call site passing an address-of, literal or array (an array member or &base->member only where the base pointer is shown valid), or by being forwarded only to null-tolerant callees. assert() is no validation, and neither is a config-macro-only guard. A callee outside the pinned tree (wolfSSL, OpenSSL, libnl) is not shown null-tolerant, so a parameter forwarded only to one stays TP.

RESULT: 140 rows. 121 TP stand (reason restated to the TP basis; source unchanged), including 7 crypto_wolfssl.c/tls_wolfssl.c rows whose parameter is forwarded only to wolfSSL APIs. 19 are corrected TP -> FP here, a flip rate of 13.6%. A fresh-context refuter reviewed all 19 and upheld all of them, checking the shared sha1_vector (27 sites), omac1_aes_128_vector (9), SHA1Init (6) and SHA1Final (5) caller sets and finding no function-pointer use of any flipped function. It corrected two reasons' line citations (crypto_openssl.c:829, ms_funcs.c:357), and the corrected wording is used.

Mechanics follow bmdb 1490/1531 and the 1541 pilot: in-place edits keep each key; task-644-full-reaudit takes a row_count decrement and a superseded_rows record.

Counting basis: distinct (project, commit, file, line, rule) keys. No precision claim is made here.
